items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: Most projects are completed in 3–6 weeks, depending on scope and how quickly content is provided. The audit and proposal phase takes 1–2 weeks, then build and launch takes 2–4 weeks.

items.q: Do you work with businesses outside Batumi?
items.a: Yes. I focus on Batumi-based businesses in hospitality, medical, and beauty, and I can support projects across Georgia when the website needs multilingual content for international visitors.

items.q: What if I already have a website?
items.a: I start every engagement with a website audit. If your existing site can be improved, I'll tell you exactly what needs fixing. If it makes more sense to rebuild, I'll explain why with clear reasoning — no pressure either way.

items.q: Can you help with content and photos?
items.a: I handle content strategy, copywriting, and image optimization as part of every project. For high-end photography and video, I partner with local professionals. I never use generic stock photos as primary visuals.

items.q: What's included in the monthly fee?
items.a: Hosting management, security updates, performance monitoring, minor content updates, and priority support. Think of it as a retainer that keeps your site fast, secure, and current — without surprise invoices.

items.q: Do you offer SEO services?
items.a: Technical SEO, local SEO setup (Google Business Profile), structured data implementation, and performance optimization are included in every project. For ongoing content SEO and paid advertising, I can recommend trusted partners.

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Batumi Lighthouse ("we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.
privacy.data_collection_body:
We may collect the following types of personal data:

• Contact information: name, email address, phone number, and business name when you submit a form or contact us.
• Website data: your current website URL when provided during an audit request or inquiry.
• Usage data: pages visited, time spent on pages, and general navigation patterns collected through privacy-respecting analytics.
• Device data: browser type, operating system, and screen resolution for optimizing your experience.
privacy.cookies_body: We use essential cookies to ensure the website functions properly. We may also use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our site. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings at any time. We do not use advertising cookies or sell data to third-party advertisers.
privacy.third_party_body:
We may use the following third-party services that process your data:

• Hosting providers (e.g., Hostinger) for serving our website securely.
• Form processing tools to manage inquiries and audit requests.
• Analytics services to understand website traffic and performance.

Each third-party service operates under its own privacy policy. We only share data necessary for the service to function.
privacy.data_rights_body:
You have the right to:

• Access the personal data we hold about you.
• Request correction or deletion of your data.
• Object to processing of your data for specific purposes.
• Request a copy of your data in a portable format.

To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.
privacy.data_security_body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.contact_body:
If you have questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, please contact us:

Email: hello@batumilighthouse.com
Location: Batumi, Adjara, Georgia

hero.title: Hotel websites for more direct enquiries
hero.subtitle: Websites for Batumi hotels, guesthouses, and aparthotels that show rooms clearly, support multilingual guests, and make direct booking or contact easier.

items.title: Too much dependence on third-party booking sites
items.description: Third-party booking sites can be useful, but relying on them alone makes it harder to own guest relationships. Your website should help guests contact or book with you directly.

items.title: Slow booking flow
items.description: Slow pages and heavy images make guests leave before they compare rooms. I plan lighter pages and clearer room content.

items.title: No multilingual content
items.description: Batumi welcomes Georgian, Russian, Turkish, and international visitors. If your site only speaks one language, you're invisible to most of your market.

items.title: Poor mobile experience
items.description: Many guests check hotel options from a phone. Your site needs to be easy to read, compare, and contact on mobile.

items.title: Room & offer pages
items.description: Beautiful, fast-loading room pages with photo galleries, amenity lists, and clear rate presentation — built to convert browsers into bookers.

items.title: Direct booking integration
items.description: Connect your preferred booking tool, calendar, or enquiry form so guests can move from room details to the next step.

items.title: Multilingual guest paths
items.description: Full content in Georgian, Russian, and English — so every guest finds what they need in their language, from room details to local tips.

items.title: Clear rate and offer display
items.description: Room rates, packages, and seasonal offers are shown clearly, with any booking rules explained in plain language.

items.title: Speed optimization
items.description: Image optimization, lazy loading, and launch checks to keep pages fast on real devices.

items.title: Analytics & CRO
items.description: Conversion tracking, booking funnel analytics, and ongoing recommendations so you can see exactly what's working and what to improve.

outcomes.heading: What this looks like in practice

items.title: A guest finds your hotel in their language, checks rooms, and contacts or books directly.
items.description: A traveller lands on your language-specific page, compares rooms with clear pricing, and uses your booking or contact option without extra confusion.

items.title: Your seasonal offers are easier to find before guests book elsewhere.
items.description: A focused page for your summer package loads quickly on mobile, explains the offer, and links to the booking or enquiry step.

items.title: Repeat guests book directly because they remember your site works.
items.description: Returning visitors find your site fast, clean, and easy to navigate. No pop-ups, no confusion — just a direct path to booking their favorite room.

items.q: Can you connect my site with my channel manager or booking provider?
items.a: Yes. I can build a website that works alongside your channel manager or booking tools. I avoid making claims about rate parity until we review your setup and provider rules.

items.q: What payment processing do you support?
items.a: I integrate with popular payment gateways including Stripe, TBC, and Bank of Georgia. The right choice depends on your guest demographics and existing banking relationships — I'll recommend the best fit during our consultation.

items.q: How do you handle seasonal pricing?
items.a: Your booking tool handles rate logic. I make sure the website presents room and offer information clearly and uses the current details your tool provides.

items.q: Do you support multi-property websites?
items.a: Yes. If you operate multiple properties, I can build a unified site with property-specific sections, shared booking infrastructure, and centralized content management. Each property maintains its own identity while benefiting from shared SEO authority.

items.q: Can I update room content myself?
items.a: Yes. A hospitality site can include a simple editor for room descriptions, photos, amenities, and offers. I also provide training and ongoing support.

cta.heading: Ready to improve your hospitality website?

hero.title: Websites that build patient trust before the first consultation
hero.subtitle: Your Batumi clinic, dental practice, or aesthetic center needs a website that helps patients understand treatments, doctors, languages, and how to request an appointment.

items.title: Low patient trust online
items.description: Patients choose clinics they trust. If your website doesn't convey professionalism, expertise, and care, they'll find one that does — usually a competitor.

items.title: No doctor profiles
items.description: Patients want to know who will treat them. Without detailed doctor profiles, qualifications, and specializations, your website can't build the trust that leads to bookings.

items.title: Missing consultation flow
items.description: If a patient can't easily request or book a consultation, that trust you've built goes nowhere. A clear, simple path from interest to appointment is essential.

items.title: No multilingual clarity
items.description: Batumi's medical tourism serves Georgian, Russian, and international patients. Content in only one language means you're invisible to a significant portion of your potential patients.

items.title: Doctor & treatment profiles
items.description: Detailed, professional profiles for every specialist — qualifications, experience, areas of expertise, and patient-facing descriptions that build confidence.

items.title: Consultation booking
items.description: A clean consultation request flow that works on every device. Patients choose the relevant service or doctor and send an enquiry.

items.title: Multilingual medical content
items.description: Accurate, professional content in Georgian, Russian, and English — translated with medical terminology precision, not machine-translation guesswork.

items.title: Structured data (MedicalBusiness schema)
items.description: Schema.org MedicalBusiness markup that helps Google understand your clinic, doctors, and services — improving your visibility in local medical search results.

items.title: Review management
items.description: Review collection and display options that help show credible patient feedback, with your approval before anything goes live.

items.title: FAQ section
items.description: A searchable FAQ section with structured data that answers common patient questions — reducing phone inquiries and improving your SEO with FAQ rich results.

outcomes.heading: What this looks like in practice

items.title: A patient reads about your specialists in their language, trusts the presentation, and books a consultation.
items.description: A Russian-speaking patient finds your clinic on Google, reads a detailed profile of the specialist in Russian, reviews available treatments, and books a consultation — all in a single session.

items.title: Your clinic appears in Google's local medical results with rich information.
items.description: Structured data markup means Google shows your doctors, specialties, and patient ratings directly in search results — giving patients the confidence to click through before they even visit your site.

items.title: Fewer phone calls, more online consultations.
items.description: With clear FAQs and appointment options, patients can find answers before they call reception.

items.q: How do you handle patient data privacy?
items.a: Consultation forms use secure transmission. I build with privacy and data-protection requirements in mind. Patient data is not stored on the marketing pages unless that is agreed and configured properly.

items.q: Can you create multilingual medical content?
items.a: Yes. I work with professional medical translators to ensure accuracy in Georgian, Russian, and English. Medical terminology is precise — I never rely on machine translation for clinical content.

items.q: Do you integrate with insurance or practice software?
items.a: I can connect to practice software or scheduling tools when they provide APIs or embeddable widgets. During the fit call, I review what you use and recommend a practical option.

items.q: What appointment tools do you support?
items.a: I can build a simple enquiry form or connect booking tools you already use. The right approach depends on your practice size and workflow.

items.q: How do you ensure medical content accuracy?
items.a: I structure content based on information you provide. You review and approve all medical claims, treatment descriptions, and doctor qualifications before publication. I provide the page structure; you provide the clinical authority.

cta.heading: Ready to improve your medical website?

demo_audit.title: Batumi Hotel Website Audit
demo_audit.executiveSummary: This Batumi seafront hotel website has strong visual appeal but struggles with the fundamentals that drive direct bookings. Mobile performance is critically slow, the booking flow requires too many steps, and the site is nearly invisible in local search results. The good news: these are fixable problems with clear, prioritized actions.

findings.title: Slow-feeling mobile first load
findings.description: The homepage appears heavier than it needs to be on mobile because large hero imagery and extra scripts compete for the first screen. A lighter image and script budget would make the first visit feel faster and more reliable.
findings.recommendedFix: Compress and resize hero images, remove unnecessary blocking scripts, lazy-load non-critical media, and test the page against Core Web Vitals before launch.

findings.title: Booking flow asks for too many decisions
findings.description: The booking path asks visitors to move through several decisions before they reach a clear next step. Extra decision points can reduce confidence and increase drop-off, especially on mobile.
findings.recommendedFix: Put room choice, policies, and the booking/contact handoff closer together, then keep the direct booking CTA visible on room and offer pages.

findings.title: No Google Business Profile integration
findings.description: The hotel has a Google Business Profile but the website doesn't link to it, and the profile has inconsistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) data. There is no structured data markup (Schema.org Hotel) on any page. The site does not appear in the local pack for 'hotel Batumi' queries.
findings.recommendedFix: Add Hotel schema markup to every room page, keep NAP data consistent across listings, and link the Google Business Profile from the site footer.

findings.title: Room pages lack multilingual content
findings.description: Room descriptions are not equally clear across the languages guests are likely to use. Russian-speaking or English-speaking visitors may leave if room details, policies, and contact options are not available in a language they understand.
findings.recommendedFix: Prioritize complete English, Georgian, and Russian room and policy content, then review search snippets and contact prompts for each language.

findings.title: Low contrast on key CTAs
findings.description: The 'Book Now' button uses low-contrast text on a light background, making an important action harder to read. Room images lack alt text. No skip-navigation link is present.
findings.recommendedFix: Increase button contrast to meet WCAG AA, add descriptive alt text to room images, and add a skip-to-content link at the top of the page.
